market_hours: regular hours only (Alpaca daily bars are RTH-only by default)
calendar_handling: no explicit holiday filtering needed - Alpaca daily bars only include actual trading days
dividends: not modeled - adjustment=split adjusts for splits only, not dividends; a minor understatement of buy-and-hold total return for dividend-paying symbols (SPY, QQQ, DIA, IWM, AAPL all pay dividends), documented as a caveat
fees: Alpaca US equities are commission-free; SEC/FINRA regulatory fees are negligible at this trade size and were excluded - see fee_source.json
